explanation: An ancient people group who lived in the coastal regions of Canaan, present-day Israel and Gaza. They were often in conflict with the Israelites.
The Philistine king of the city of Gath, whom David sought refuge with when he fled from King Saul.
Future king of Israel and Judah, known for his bravery and skill as a warrior. He is also the author of several psalms in the Book of Psalms.
The first king of Israel, chosen by the prophet Samuel. His disobedience to God led God to reject him as king and choose David instead.
A city in Canaan where the Philistine army gathered before going into battle against the Israelites.
A nomadic tribe that lived south of Canaan and had frequent clashes with the Israelites.
A people group who lived in the Negev desert and parts of Sinai. They were enemies of the Israelites and had several conflicts with them.
A city in southern Israel that was given to David by Achish as a base for him and his men.
